result.summary: Do not ship: Save Settings now silently resets General settings and ignores edits to them.

findings.title: Splitting the forms drops General fields on every settings save
findings.body: The General controls now belong to a separate form with no submit button. Clicking Save Settings submits only the instance form, omitting every General field. In triggarr/web/routes.py:531–539, missing values become defaults rather than preserving current settings: for example, hard_max_per_cycle=10 becomes 0 (unlimited), and skip_unreleased=true becomes false. These values are persisted and applied at runtime. General edits therefore cannot be saved through the button, and ordinary instance saves silently disable configured search restrictions.
findings.recommendation: Restore id="settings-form" on the instance form and form="settings-form" on all General controls, keeping the Security forms separate.

next_steps: Restore the shared form association and run tests/test_web.py::test_general_fields_submit_with_the_save_settings_form.
